payload.type: flags uint8 | username string | password string | encryptionKey string | digest (16 bytes) | nonce uint32

logon_params.stream_order: flags, username, password, encryptionKey, [digest if HAS_DIGEST], nonce

callbacks.name: start
callbacks.detail: begins the login; arms a 1s retry and 8s timeout per attempt, up to 10 attempts

callbacks.name: sendNextRequest
callbacks.detail: creates a LoginRequest and sends LoginInterface::login (or challengeResponse then login)

callbacks.name: onReply
callbacks.detail: reads the reply status uint8; branches on it

callbacks.name: onLoginAppLoginChallengeIssued
callbacks.detail: only on LOGIN_CHALLENGE_ISSUED (66): create the challenge, then run it

callbacks.name: onLoginChallengeCompleted
callbacks.detail: only on challenge path: resets the attempt count and re-sends

callbacks.name: onLoginAppLoginSuccess
callbacks.detail: on LOGGED_ON (1): takes LoginReplyRecord {serverAddr, sessionKey} + optional serverMsg, switches to the BaseApp protocol

callbacks.name: sendNextRequest
callbacks.detail: re-sends to the BaseApp address from the reply record

callbacks.name: onBaseAppLoginSuccess
callbacks.detail: takes the winning channel and sessionKey; the sessionKey must be nonzero and differ from the reply record's

callbacks.name: finish
callbacks.detail: cancels timers, drops the child requests, sets the connection's session key and channel

callbacks.name: onLoginComplete
callbacks.detail: the LoginCompletionCallback the caller set; the login has completed

reject_path: onReply -> fail(status, serverMessage) for any non-LOGGED_ON status; onAttemptsExhausted -> LOGIN_REJECTED_NO_LOGINAPP_RESPONSE (92)
